name: Anhui Korrun Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Korrun Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, production, and sales of various travel products in China and internationally. Its products include trolley cases, backpacks, suitcases, apparel, and related accessories. The company also offers sports and leisure bags; business bags; and other functional soft bags. It sells its products through e-commerce channels such as Tmall, JD.com, Douyin, and Xiaomi. Anhui Korrun Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Shanghai, China.
